situation (example wording): "what is the defanition of simple assault", "What is defined as violent crime", "how is domestic violence defined in NIBRS?", "what counts as personal weapons", "SRS definition please"
what the app does today: A link to the FBI Crime Data Explorer for every definition question.
proposed behavior: Simple assault: the FBI NIBRS offense 13B definition as published. Domestic violence: NIBRS has no such offense; it is recorded through the victim-to-offender relationship codes, and is not the same as Family Offenses, Nonviolent (90F). Personal weapons: NIBRS weapon code 40, hands, fists, feet and teeth. SRS: the Summary Reporting System, the FBI's older summary reporting program (a program, not an offense). Violent crime has two definitions chosen by context: SRS or Crime Index context gives murder and nonnegligent manslaughter, rape, robbery and aggravated assault; NIBRS context gives the same four as codes (09A; 11A, 11B and 11C; 120; 13A); no context gives both, each labeled with its program. Any other term keeps the link.
why: Jeff 2026-11-25 via the Coordinator. The NIBRS violent set matches the product's violent crime composite (09A, 11A-C, 120, 13A).
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-coverage.ts (every term above, violent crime by program, the link kept for other terms).
